translation.question: 2025年フィリピン総選挙の下院選挙において、小選挙区制以外の投票にはどのような選挙制度が使用されますか？
translation.expected_answer: 修正政党名簿比例代表制
translation.translation_note: FPTP is translated as 小選挙区制 (single-member district / first-past-the-post) which is the standard Japanese term in this context.

backtranslation_en.question: In the House of Representatives election of the 2025 Philippine general election, what electoral system is used for voting other than the single-member district system?
